[[File:LignanCrystal.jpg|thumb|right|Crystals of Lignan ore were used in the construction of lightsabers.]]
'''Lignan''' was a rare [[Ore/Legends|ore]] that was extremely powerful in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Though its origins were within the [[Ligna system/Legends|Ligna System]], one of the only other places it could be found was in the [[Phaegon system/Legends|Phaegon system]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Phaegon III]]. If drawn upon while the [[Darksider|user]] was utilizing [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the ore was able to greatly augment the user's [[Force power/Legends|abilities]], although the ore itself burned to ash as it was used up. It was noted to give a light-headed feeling after its use. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] sent [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Saes Rrogon]] with the [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']] and [[Yaru Korsin]] with the ''[[Omen]]'' to [[Mining/Legends|mine]] Lignan ore for use during the impending [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. However, their mission was foiled when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Relin Druur]] and Druur's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Drev Hassin]], [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|assaulted]] the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. As the Sith attempted to escape, the ''Omen'' was knocked off-course to the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], where the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith survivors]] remained stranded until [[41 ABY]], while the ''Harbinger'' jumped through an unstable [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], causing it to [[Time travel/Legends|travel]] through [[Time/Legends|time]] to 41 ABY. The ''Omen'' survivors used the Lignan to make [[Lignan crystal]]s to use as [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] for the highest ranking members of their Tribe.
